name: Overlays
description: Browse, preview and install community emulator overlays from the LoveRetro/nextui-community-overlays repository directly on your handheld. Auto-detects installed emu paks (e.g. MGBA, GAMBATTE, SUPA) and resolution-aware overlay paths.
author: zolek86

changelog.v0.1.1: Fix release packaging: zip the pak contents directly so the Pak Store no longer creates a nested Overlays.pak/Overlays.pak/ folder on install.
changelog.v0.1.0: Initial release. System browser, fullscreen preview, install with auto-generated .cfg, alias detection (GBA -> MGBA, SFC -> SUPA, etc.), resolution-aware install paths.
